## Summary

Describe the behavior and why it belongs in nixpi.

## Compatibility

List public API effects, deprecations, and migration requirements. Write `none` when there are no public effects.

## Verification

- [ ] `nix fmt`
- [ ] `nix flake check -L`
- [ ] `nix flake check --all-systems --no-build -L`
- [ ] Documentation and tests cover the change
